caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass pitcher with a vertically ribbed pattern on its body. The pitcher features a spout and a curved handle on the right side. The rim of the pitcher is outlined with a thick, dark blue border. The glass itself appears transparent with detailed gray shading to suggest reflections and the three-dimensional form of the object. The background is plain and uncolored, and the pitcher is centered on the page. In the lower left corner, the name "JOHN DIANA" is written in small letters.
title: Small Pitcher
